title: AI Engineer
description:
Requirements and responsibilities


We’re seeking a AI Engineer to design, develop, and deploy AI and machine learning solutions for real\-world business needs. This role requires strong experience working with both custom\-built and pre\-trained models—spanning LLMs, computer vision, NLP, and traditional ML—and delivering them into production through APIs, web applications, or microservices.

### **Responsibilities**


Build, train, and deploy machine learning and AI models across supervised, unsupervised, and deep learning workflows.


Integrate and fine\-tune pre\-trained models (LLMs, vision, NLP) from platforms such as OpenAI, Anthropic, AWS Bedrock, Azure AI, and Hugging Face.


Develop end\-to\-end ML pipelines covering data processing, model training, and inference.


Create APIs, web applications, and microservices to serve models in production environments.


Work closely with data and software engineering teams to deliver scalable, maintainable systems.


Optimize models for performance, latency, scalability, and cost.


Implement model evaluation, monitoring, and performance tracking.


Stay updated on emerging AI tools, frameworks, and techniques.

### **Requirements**


Demonstrated experience developing and deploying ML models (regression, classification, NLP, computer vision).


Strong proficiency in Python and major ML/DL frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or Keras.


Hands\-on experience with AI APIs and SDKs (OpenAI, Anthropic, AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, etc.).


Ability to build RESTful APIs, web apps, or microservices using FastAPI, Flask, or Django.


Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).


Experience with semantic databases (Neo4j, RDF stores, knowledge graphs) and relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL).


Solid understanding of version control, model evaluation, and deployment best practices.

### **Preferred**


Experience with MLOps workflows (CI/CD, model registries, monitoring, governance).


Knowledge of data orchestration tools (Airflow, Prefect, Kafka).


Exposure to vector databases (FAISS, Pinecone, Weaviate) and RAG architectures.


Familiarity with prompt engineering or LLM fine\-tuning.


Experience building AI\-driven applications such as chatbots or recommendation engines.

title: Senior AI Engineer (Microsoft Stack)
location: Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
description:
**Length of Contract: 1 Year with possibility of extension** 




  





 Our MNC Client is seeking for an AI Engineer who is an expert in "Pro\-Code" AI development to lead the architecture and implementation of our enterprise\-grade agentic systems. You will be building the orchestration layers, the governance guardrails, and the custom interfaces that power autonomous business workflows.
 



 The ideal candidate lives in the Microsoft AI Platform ecosystem but approaches development with a software engineering mindset prioritizing scalability, security (via Citadel), and complex multi\-agent orchestration.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**1\. Agentic Orchestration \& Design** 



* Architect and develop complex multi\-agent systems using the Microsoft Agent Framework (integrating patterns from Semantic Kernel and AutoGen).
* Implement Agent\-to\-Agent (A2A) communication and Model Context Protocol (MCP) to allow agents to discover and invoke enterprise tools dynamically.
* Design hybrid orchestration models: combining Agentic Reasoning (dynamic) with Workflow Orchestration(deterministic business logic).



**2\. AI Governance \& Security (The Citadel Layer)** 



* Deploy and manage the Foundry Citadel Platform to ensure unified governance, cost control, and observability across all AI workloads.
* Implement AI Gateway patterns to enforce enterprise policies, content safety (Prompt Shields), and managed guardrails.
* Utilize Citadel’s Agent\-Level Tracing and automated evaluations to monitor performance and compliance in real\-time.



**3\. Pro\-Code Backend \& Data Engineering** 



* Build robust RAG (Retrieval\-Augmented Generation) pipelines using Foundry IQ and Azure AI Search for high\-accuracy, multi\-hop reasoning.
* Develop backend services in Python or C\# (.NET) to serve as the "brain" for AI agents, integrating with Microsoft Fabric and Dataverse.
* Automate the AI lifecycle (LLMOps) using GitHub Actions and Azure DevOps for CI/CD of prompt flows and model deployments.



**4\. UI \& Frontend Integration** 



* Develop custom, responsive user interfaces using React or Streamlit that allow humans to interact with, supervise, and steer AI agents.
* Integrate agentic workflows into existing surfaces like Microsoft Teams, custom web portals, or the VS Code AI Toolkit.

title: Senior Product Manager - AI Agent Platform
description:
### **About Lucidya**


Lucidya is a leading AI\-powered Customer Experience Management (CXM) platform that enables brands to listen, understand, and engage with their customers across multiple channels. As part of our ambitious growth and innovation roadmap, we are launching a new AI Agent platform designed to automate and elevate customer interactions through cutting\-edge artificial intelligence.


This is a strategic, ground\-floor opportunity to join a small, dedicated team at the forefront of an emerging market. You won’t just manage tasks \- you will shape the product’s vision, strategy, and execution, leaving a tangible mark on a transformative platform.

### **Role Overview**


As the Senior Product Manager for the AI Agent platform, you will own the entire product lifecycle \- from defining and refining the roadmap to driving discovery with clients, collaborating closely with engineering and design teams, and delivering high\-impact features that meet evolving market and customer needs.


You will be the key driver ensuring that our AI Agent delivers exceptional customer experience every day, continuously improving based on data, feedback, and market trends.

### **Your Team \& Collaboration**


You will lead a high\-performing, cross\-functional team that includes:

* 2 Front\-end Engineers
* 2 Backend Engineers
* 3 AI Engineers
* 1 Senior Product Designer
* 1 Software Quality Assurance Specialist
* Solution Consultant


Your collaboration extends across Lucidya’s broader product teams (Social Listening, Engage), Sales and Customer Success teams, clients for discovery and validation, external integration partners, and AI leadership (Director of AI, AI Agent Engineering Manager).

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Own and drive the product roadmap for the AI Agent platform, aligning priorities with business goals and client needs.
* Lead continuous discovery efforts with customers and internal stakeholders to validate and refine product direction.
* Define product scope, releases, and success metrics; monitor agent performance post\-launch.
* Translate client feedback into actionable product improvements and feature enhancements.
* Collaborate with AI engineers to define agent use cases and capabilities.
* Identify and prioritize integrations with third\-party platforms and Lucidya modules based on business value.
* Stay abreast of AI Agent industry trends and emerging technologies, evaluating their potential impact on our product.
* Test and vet new tools and technologies to drive innovation and efficiency.

### **Day\-to\-Day Activities**

* Conduct regular sync meetings with engineering and design teams for alignment on scope, priorities, and delivery timelines.
* Prioritize and manage the product backlog in support of roadmap execution.
* Engage in client discovery sessions and calls to gather insights and validate product decisions.
* Write and refine detailed product specifications and user stories.
* Review designs and provide constructive feedback to ensure usability and alignment.
* Track and analyze product KPIs and agent performance data.
* Coordinate with cross\-functional stakeholders to ensure seamless product delivery.

### **What Success Looks Like**

* Rapidly shape and execute a clear product vision and roadmap that resonates with client needs and market opportunities.
* Establish robust discovery and feedback loops that consistently improve product\-market fit.
* Deliver scalable AI Agent features and integrations that drive customer satisfaction and business growth.
* Foster strong collaboration and communication across technical and non\-technical teams.
* Demonstrate agility in navigating an evolving AI landscape and fast\-moving market dynamics.

### **Challenges You’ll Overcome**

* Navigating the fast\-evolving AI Agent market by continuously monitoring trends and making strategic decisions.
* Extracting true client pain points when customer understanding of AI capabilities may be limited.
* Quickly ramping up on technical and AI concepts to effectively partner with engineers and AI experts.

**Requirements**


Experience:

* 5\+ years as a Product Manager in B2B SaaS environments.
* Experience with AI\-powered products is a strong plus (focus on building AI\-enabled features, not AI model development).


Skills \& Qualifications:

* Native Arabic speaker with professional proficiency in English.
* Exceptional discovery skills to extract actionable insights from client feedback.
* Strong prioritization and decision\-making abilities, balancing trade\-offs effectively.
* Comfortable working closely with engineering teams and understanding technical concepts.
* Excellent communication skills for diverse stakeholder engagement.
* Creative and logical thinker with a hands\-on mindset \- willing to explore new tools and technologies.
* Adaptable to ambiguity in a fast\-paced, evolving product environment.
* Market\-aware: continuously researches AI, CXM, and competitive trends.

### **Interview Process**

* MawHub Screening
* Technical Interview with Kassem Bagher (AI Agent Engineering Manager) \& Hasan Al\-Hendi (Head of Product)
* Final Interview with Tarik Shalby (General Manager \- AI Agent) \& Qaiser Khan (Director of AI)


If you’re passionate about AI, customer experience, and building products that redefine how brands engage with customers, we want to hear from you. Join us and help shape the future of AI\-driven customer interactions.

title: Senior AI Engineer (Agentic Systems & Inference) - Onsite
description:
As a Senior AI Engineer, you will be the primary architect of Cognna’s autonomous agent reasoning engine and the high\-scale inference infrastructure that powers it. You are responsible for building production\-grade reasoning systems that proactively plan, use tools, and collaborate. You will own the full lifecycle of our specialized security models, from domain\-specific fine\-tuning to architecting distributed, high\-throughput inference services that serve as Security\-core intelligence in our platform.

### **Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Agentic Architecture \& Multi\-Agent Coordination**

* Autonomous Orchestration: Design stateful, multi\-agent systems using frameworks like Google ADK.
* Protocol\-First Integration: Architect and scale MCP servers and A2A interfaces, ensuring a decoupled and extensible agent ecosystem.
* Cognitive Optimization: Develop lean, high\-reasoning microservices for deep reasoning, optimizing context token usage to maintain high planning accuracy with minimal latency.

**2\. Model Adaptation \& Performance Engineering**

* Specialized Fine\-Tuning: Lead the architectural strategy for fine\-tuning open\-source and proprietary models on massive cybersecurity\-specific telemetry.
* Advanced Training Regimes: Implement Quantization\-Aware Training (QAT) and manage Adapter\-based architectures to enable the dynamic loading of task\-specific specialists without the overhead of full\-model swaps.
* Evaluation Frameworks: Engineer rigorous, automated evaluation harnesses (including Human annotations and AI\-judge patterns) to measure agent groundedness and resilience against the Security Engineer’s adversarial attack trees.

**3\. Production Inference \& MLOps at Scale**

* Distributed Inference Systems: Architect and maintain high\-concurrency inference services using engines like vLLM, TGI, or TensorRT\-LLM.
* Infrastructure Orchestration: Own the GPU/TPU resource management strategy.
* Observability \& Debugging: Implement deep\-trace observability for non\-deterministic agentic workflows, providing the visibility needed to debug complex multi\-step reasoning failures in production.

**4\. Advanced RAG \& Semantic Intelligence**

* Hybrid Retrieval Architectures: Design and optimize RAG pipelines involving graph\-like data structures, agent\-based knowledge retrieval and semantic searches.
* Memory Management: Architect episodic and persistent memory systems for agents, allowing for long\-running security investigations that persist context across sessions.

**Requirements**

* **Experience \& Education:** 5\-7\+ years in AI/ML Engineering or Backend Systems. Must have contributed to large\-scale AI/ML inference service in production. M.S. or B.S. in Computer Science/AI is preferred.
* **Inference Orchestration:** KV\-cache management, quantization formats like AWQ/FP8, and distributed serving across multi\-node GPU clusters).
* **Agentic Development:** Expert in building autonomous systems using Google ADK/Langgraph/Langchain and experienced with AI Observervability frameworks like LangSmith or Langfuse. Hands\-on experience building AI applications with MCP and A2A protocols.
* **Cloud AI Native:** Proficiency in Google Cloud (Vertex AI), including custom training pipelines, high\-performance prediction endpoints, and the broader MLOps suite.
* **Programming:** Python and experience with high\-performance backends (Go/C\+\+) for inference optimization. You are comfortable working in a Kubernetes\-native environment.
* **CI/CD:** You are comfortable working in a Kubernetes\-native environment.

**Benefits**


**Competitive Package** – Salary \+ equity options \+ performance incentives  

**Flexible \& Remote** – Work from anywhere with an outcomes\-first culture  

**Team of Experts** – Work with designers, engineers, and security pros solving real\-world problems  

**Growth\-Focused** – Your ideas ship, your voice counts, your growth matters  

**Global Impact** – Build products that protect critical systems and data

title: AI Engineer
description:
**About the role**
------------------


Mercura is building AI software for the backbone of our economy.


We are one of the fastest growing companies from YC’s W25 batch and raised a heavily oversubscribed round at one of the highest valuations in our cohort. After surpassing $1M in ARR in under a year, we are looking for team members ready to go all\-in to help us reach our next milestone: **$10M ARR by the end of 2026\.**


One of our co\-founders, Lukas, grew up in a trades family that has been active in the construction industry for over 115 years. Having worked on the construction site himself, he learned first\-hand how slow and manual quoting still is in the industry.


In an era where AI becomes ubiquitous, we set out on a deeply personal mission: bring AI to the backbone of our economy \- to the companies that keep our world running.


As an **AI Engineer**, you will play a key role in **building AI systems end\-to\-end**. This is a **fast\-paced, hands\-on** role for engineers with high agency, strong technical depth and founder mindset. You’ll apply the latest technologies in NLP, LLMs, and AI agents \- far beyond prompt engineering \- while working alongside a team of the most stellar engineers.


If you’re a **passionate builder** who excels at the intersection of **LLMs, NLP, AI, data engineering, and full\-stack development**, this is your opportunity to shape how users interact with AI.

**What you will be working on**
-------------------------------

* Work with embeddings and fine\-tune LLMs for classification and reranking
* Optimize algorithms for product search
* Apply RLHF \& DPO to align LLMs with human feedback
* Build data \& ML pipelines to process large\-scale unstructured data efficiently
* Build, deploy and optimize AI agents end\-to\-end
* Own the architecture and design of AI systems
* Collaborate with other stellar engineers across the full stack

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

**We are looking for stellar engineers with a strong background in LLMs, AI \& ML \- and the potential to grow and lead teams in the future.**


Technical skillset:

* Strong experience with **NLP, LLMs, Embeddings, ML, and AI agents** that goes far beyond prompt engineering (e.g., LoRA, tool calling / structured outputs, evals, retrievers / rerankers, RLHF/DPO)
* Proven track record of architecting and building **complex, production\-grade AI systems**
* Demonstrated experience in **scaling data \& ML pipelines** from a few users to thousands of users
* Experience with **full\-stack software engineering** (React, Typescript, Python) is a plus
* **Cloud \& DevOps**: Experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), cloud infrastructure (Azure/AWS/GCP), and infrastructure as code (Terraform) is a plus


Commitment \& mindset:

* **High agency \& ownership**: You develop new ideas and drive them in execution under minimal guidance
* **Mission\-driven**: Your job is part of how you define yourself. You treat your work as a top priority, and you’re fully committed to achieving ambitious goals amid uncertainty
* **Product mindset**: You demonstrate product thinking on a deep level and solve problems end\-to\-end
* You’re excited to **iterate quickly** and build software in a fast\-paced startup environment
* You want to work **in\-person in Munich** with a higher **intensity** than in a 9\-5 job


Leadership \& communication:

* You naturally **take responsibility** and enjoy leading teams
* You’re one of the **strongest engineers in the team** and make everyone else better
* Everyone can come to you for advice on how to **fix their hardest problems**
* Clients respect your presence \& technical expertise

**Company Perks**
-----------------

* Free team dinner (up to 4x/week)
* UrbanSportsClub membership \- join our team workouts 3x/week
* Easy relocation to Munich — our office is located in the **Werk1 Startup Incubator**, where you can rent a 1\-bedroom apartment right next to the office for just €750/month
* Real shares in our company with the most favorable tax treatment \- no VSOP/ESOP
* Access to any AI or productivity tools you need


The target total compensation (cash\+bonus\+equity) for this position is **€90,000\-€200,000 annually.** Actual offers and compensation are based on specific job duties, experience, performance, total rewards structure, and other considerations.

**About the interview**
-----------------------

**Step 1: Intro call**


Casual intro meeting with one of the founders to get to know each other and introduce Mercura

**Step 2: Technical interview**


The technical interview consists of two parts:

* A take\-home exercise, including a short presentation.
* A system design interview.


For the take\-home exercise, we’d provide you with a task. You’ll have 2–3 hours to complete it, focusing on AI engineering (e.g., NLP, embeddings, LLMs). The challenge will be based on a practical problem we’ve encountered in our day\-to\-day work, so it should give you a realistic sense of what the role involves.


Later, you’ll present your results to us.

**Step 3: Personal Fit**


Meet another co\-founder to get a feel for our culture and working style.

**Step 4: On\-Site**


Work alongside the entire team for a day on\-site from our Munich office to fully immerse yourself in our culture and collaboration style. This on\-site will be paid.

**Step 5: Offer \& Reference Checks**


If we see a great fit, you will get an offer, including a competitive compensation package with equity participation. At the same time, we’ll ask you to provide 2–3 references so we can gather additional insights into your strengths and working style.

**About Mercura**
-----------------

***You know someone great? Introduce them to*** ***founders@mercura.ai*** ***and get up to €10,000 in referral bonuses if we hire them!\****


Mercura is building AI software for the backbone of our economy.


We are one of the fastest growing companies from YC’s W25 batch and raised a heavily oversubscribed round at one of the highest valuations in our cohort. After surpassing $1M in ARR in under a year, we are looking for team members ready to go all\-in to help us reach our next milestone: **$10M ARR by the end of 2026**.


One of our co\-founders, Lukas, grew up in a trades family that has been active in the construction industry for over 115 years. Having worked on the construction site himself, he learned first\-hand how slow and manual quoting still is in the industry.


In an era where AI becomes ubiquitous, we set out on a deeply personal mission: bring AI to the backbone of our economy \- to the companies that keep our world running.

**WHY MERCURA**

* **Join an ambitious team** that feels like family: Your future colleagues include top graduates, Science Olympiad medallists, ex\-founders and come from places such as **Google, Bain, MIT, TUM, Harvard, CDTM, and Cambridge**. We bring extraordinary people together and deeply invest in your growth as your mentors, teammates and friends. We care, trust, and support one another like family, and we make sure that fun is at the heart of everything we do.
* **Work with the latest tech**: AI is at the core of our product. As we are backed by **Y Combinator**, and leverage the latest tech to push the boundaries of LLMs and ML. With us, you’ll tackle meaningful challenges and shape how users interact with AI.
* **Thrive in a high\-growth, high\-commitment environment**: We’re growing extremely fast because we work hard and always put our customers first. If you excel in fast\-paced settings and want to **grow as part of something big from day one**, Mercura is for you.
* **Build something with real\-world impact**: We ship code that directly helps a massive, yet overlooked manual industry run more efficiently and sustainably. With us, you can work on AI that contributes to economic growth and stability on a huge scale.
* **Build our company**: As an early team member, you will have a direct, lasting impact on our culture, technology, and product. Joining us offers immense rewards: ownership, financial upside, and the unique opportunity to learn and build something extraordinary from the ground up.

**ABOUT THE FOUNDERS**


We are Lukas, Stefan \& Sean, the co\-founders of Mercura. We share a deep commitment to excellence and the discipline to pursue what others might consider impossible. Two of us come from non\-academic families, and we all know what it means to create our own paths and overcome barriers. This experience shapes our belief in equal opportunity and fuels our dedication to social mobility.


At Mercura, we believe that the best ideas emerge when people from different backgrounds collaborate together. We hire based on ability, mindset, and values, and we live by one simple rule: the best idea wins.

We care, trust, and support one another, and we make sure that joy and collaboration is at the heart of everything we do.

We’re always looking for talented individuals. If no role matches your skills, send us an open application at **founders@mercura.ai** or connect with us via LinkedIn.

title: (Senior) LLM / AI Engineer (m/f/d) Predictive Maintenance Agent
description:
**About The Role**
**The AI Research Division of Agile Robots** 
 is looking for a motivated and experienced (Senior) LLM / AI Engineer (m/f/d) Predictive Maintenance Agent. You will design and build AI agents that enable factory operators and engineers to analyze, understand, and optimize complex production systems using natural language. The role focuses on production\-grade LLM\-based systems that translate user intent into reliable data analysis, integrate with factory data pipelines, and support predictive intelligence use cases in real industrial environments.
   

  

 Your Responsibilities
   

  

* AI Agent Design: Design and implement LLM\-based agents that perform multi\-step reasoning, tool invocation, and structured data analysis with reliability and determinism.
* Data Analysis Automation: Build systems that translate natural\-language requests into complex analytical workflows over factory and production\-line data.
* System Integration: Integrate AI agents with internal data collection, storage, and monitoring systems used in industrial production environments.
* Production Readiness: Ensure AI systems are testable, observable, and maintainable through robust evaluation, monitoring, and versioning practices.
* Predictive Intelligence: Support predictive maintenance and anomaly detection use cases by enabling data\-driven analysis and model interaction through AI agents.
* Deployment Collaboration: Work closely with other teams during on\-site deployments to validate, refine, and operate AI systems under real\-world constraints.


**Essential Skills**
* Python Engineering: Strong Python skills for production systems, including testing, packaging, and maintainable codebases.
* Applied Data Analysis \& ML: Proven experience with applied data analysis and machine learning, including statistics, data exploration, model tuning, evaluation, and deployment.
* LLM Agent Development: Hands\-on experience building LLM\-based agents involving tool calling, code generation, multi\-step reasoning, reliability or guardrails, and agent efficiency.
* Agent Frameworks \& RAG: Experience with LangChain, LangGraph, or equivalent frameworks, and with retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) systems.
* Multimodal Data Analysis: Familiarity with time\-series analysis, image processing, and multimodal LLM or VLM agents involving text and images.
* Data Systems \& Operations: Strong database fundamentals and SQL, experience with natural\-language\-to\-database querying (NL2SQL or semantic querying), and familiarity with MLOps or LLMOps practices such as evaluation, monitoring, tracing, and versioning.
* Deployment Readiness: Willingness to travel for on\-site deployments.


 Beneficial Skills
   

  

* Industrial Predictive Maintenance: Experience with predictive maintenance or anomaly detection in industrial environments, including multimodal data sources.
* System Integration: Experience designing or integrating REST\-based APIs in production systems.
* Language Skills: Chinese language proficiency.


 What we offer
   

  

* Dynamic high\-tech company combined with financial soundness and world class investors.
* Join an interdisciplinary, international team with 60\+ different nationalities in a collaborative work environment.
* Lots of development opportunities in the context of our continued growth.
* Challenging tasks and impactful projects alongside experts that enable professional and personal growth.
* Corporate Benefits Program that covers health, mobility and learning with 100 € net per month.
* Modern office facilites with a rooftop terrace overlooking Munich, free drinks \& fruits, and regular company events contribute to a good working environment.


 Apply for this job
   

  

**About Us**
**Agile Robots SE** 
 is an international high\-tech company based in Munich, Germany with a production site in Kaufbeuren and more than 2300 employees worldwide. Our mission is to bridge the gap between artificial intelligence and robotics by developing systems that combine state\-of\-the\-art force\-moment\-sensing and world\-leading image\-processing technology. This unique combination of technologies allows us to provide user\-friendly and affordable robotic solutions that enable intelligent precision assembly.
   

  

 This is made possible by our employees, who bring out the best in each and every day with creativity and enthusiasm. Become part of this team and shape the future of robotics with us!
   

  

 We are proud of our diversity and welcome your application regardless of gender and sexual identity, nationality, ethnicity, religion, age, or disability.

title: Senior Machine Learning / AI Engineer (all genders)
description:
Wir gehören zu den Top\-Adressen in der IT\-Welt und fokussieren uns auf die Optimierung der Kerngeschäfts­prozesse unserer Kunden. Durch den smarten Einsatz maßgeschneiderter IT\-Lösungen unterstützen wir unsere Kunden dabei, das Beste aus ihrem Business und aktuellen Technologien herauszuholen. Unseren Erfolg aber erreichen wir nur durch eins: die Menschen bei adesso! Sie bringen Ideen, fachliches Know how und Technologien zusammen. Gemeinsam programmieren wir (deine) Zukunft bei adesso.
   

  

**DEINE ROLLE**
* Konzeption und Implementierung: Du konzipierst und implementierst innovative AI\-Lösungen für unterschiedliche Branchen mit starkem Fokus auf Cloud\-Infrastrukturen.
* Optimierung und Automatisierung: Du unterstützt uns bei der Optimierung und Automatisierung bestehender AI\-Lösungen und sorgst damit für eine kontinuierliche Verbesserung der AI\-Produkte unserer Kunden.
* ML\-Modelle und Beratung: Du automatisierst Trainings\- und Release\-Prozesse von ML\-Modellen und berätst unsere Kunden bei der Auswahl und Implementierung moderner AI\-Plattformen und \-Frameworks.
* AI Use Cases und Geschäftsmodelle: Du unterstützt uns und unsere Kunden bei der Identifizierung und Umsetzung von innovativen AI Use Cases sowie bei der Entwicklung von neuen datengetriebenen Geschäftsmodellen.
* Teamarbeit und Weiterentwicklung: Du arbeitest gerne gemeinsam im Team beständig an der Weiterentwicklung unserer AI\-Lösungen und bist dabei technologisch stets auf dem neuesten Stand.


**DEIN PROFIL**
* Akademischer Hintergrund: Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium in der Fachrichtung Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder ein vergleichbares Studium mit relevantem Bezug
* Berufserfahrung: Mindestens zwei Jahre einschlägige Berufserfahrung mit ausgeprägtem ML\-Hintergrund und Erfahrung in der Erstellung, Bereitstellung und Pflege von ML\-Modellen in der Produktion
* Technische Fähigkeiten: Fortgeschrittene Kenntnisse in Python und den gängigen Machine Learning\-Bibliotheken sowie Erfahrungen mit MLOps\-Tools wie MLflow, KubeFlow o.ä.
* Zusatzkenntnisse: Von Vorteil sind Erfahrungen im Umgang mit großen Datenmengen sowie im Einsatz von Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, ARM).
* Teamfähigkeit und Innovationsfreude: Spaß an der Arbeit in einem agilen Team, "Out of the box"\-Denken und hohes Interesse daran, sich mit neuen Themen auseinanderzusetzen
* Sprachkenntnisse: Sehr gute Deutsch\- und gute Englischkenntnisse


 Unser Versprechen: Du wirst dich bei uns wohlfühlen! Kollegial, familiär und auf Augenhöhe – wir leben Austausch, Teamgeist und einen respektvollen Umgang miteinander. Diversität und verschiedene Blickwinkel werden bei uns genauso geschätzt wie du als Mensch. Das und viel mehr steht für unser ganz besonderes Wir\-Gefühl. Für das es sogar ein Wort gibt: adessi.
   

  

 Unsere Kultur und das Zusammenarbeiten sind geprägt von gegenseitiger Wertschätzung, Anerkennung und Unterstützung. Das verbindet uns hierarchieübergreifend – auch im Home\-Office. So belegen wir zum wiederholten Mal den 1\. Platz beim Wettbewerb „Deutschlands Beste Arbeitgeber in der ITK“!. Unser umfangreiches Trainingsangebot und ein transparentes Laufbahnstufenmodell für alle sorgen dafür, dass deine Entwicklung bei uns nicht stillsteht. Denn gemeinsam zu wachsen und Chancengeber zu sein, das ist programmiert in unserer DNA.

 En Quantia Ingeniería y Consultoría, nos especializamos en transformar procesos complejos a través de tecnologías de vanguardia como los agentes de IA, Machine Learning, la digitalización, la analítica avanzada y los gemelos digitales.  Si tienes experiencia con agentes inteligentes, te apasionan las aplicaciones de IA en el mundo real, nos encantaría saber de ti.

 A fast\-growing technology consultancy is building its AI capability in Madrid and is seeking an AI Engineer to join the team. The organisation partners with clients across financial services and investment, developing robust, real\-world AI systems that support complex, high\-stakes analytical and commercial decision\-making.

 As an AI Engineer, you will play a foundational role in shaping both the technical architecture and working culture of a newly formed team. * Take ownership of AI and machine learning initiatives from initial concept through to production
* Architect, build, and deploy ML\-driven solutions to address complex business problems
* Translate commercial and operational requirements into scalable AI applications
* Design and optimise systems using modern LLM\-based approaches
* Stay current with developments in AI research, tooling, and best practice, applying relevant innovations where appropriate
* Collaborate closely with business stakeholders, engineers, and product teams to deliver meaningful outcomes



  





**Key Skills** 




  




* Strong grounding in machine learning fundamentals, with hands\-on experience delivering ML systems in production
* Practical experience deploying large language models in real\-world environments (e.g. prompt design, retrieval\-augmented generation pipelines, agent\-based workflows)
* Understanding of LLM inference and performance concepts such as KV caching, speculative decoding, and parallelisation
* Excellent programming capability in Python, plus experience with at least one of C\+\+, Java, or .NET
* Experience working with SQL\-based databases and cloud infrastructure (AWS or Azure)
* Proactive, curious mindset with a strong sense of ownership and accountability
* Clear communicator who works well in collaborative, cross\-functional environments
* Strong academic background, including excellent academic performance prior to university and a bachelor’s degree in a quantitative discipline (e.g. Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science)
* Exposure to financial services or related domains is beneficial but not essential



  





**Benefits** 




  




* Work on AI projects with clear real\-world relevance and measurable impact
* High level of autonomy and influence from the outset
* Join a technically strong, intellectually curious team in a fast\-moving environment
* Gain insight into how financial markets and economic systems operate in practice
* Help define the standards, culture, and direction of a growing Madrid\-based team

description:
Prolific is not just another player in the AI space – we are the architects of the human data infrastructure that's reshaping the landscape of AI development. In a world where foundational AI technologies are increasingly commoditized, it's the quality and diversity of human\-generated data that truly differentiates products and models.
   

  

*The Role*
 The future of AI development relies on a critical, indispensable component: high\-quality human data. Prolific provides the world's largest and most trusted source of this data to the teams pushing the boundaries of AI technology.
   

  

 As an AI Engineer, you'll be building the intelligent systems that power the crucial interface between humans and models. You will be instrumental in shaping how next\-generation AI systems are trained, evaluated, and aligned. This is a unique opportunity to solve novel problems and have a foundational impact on the entire AI ecosystem, working with a world\-class team and the industry's leading AI labs.
   

  

*What You'll Be Doing*
* Architect \& Build: Lead the design and implementation of production\-grade AI systems that enhance how human feedback is collected, validated, and utilised across our platform.
* Solve Core Challenges: Develop sophisticated systems for fraud detection, quality assurance, and intelligent participant\-to\-task matching using techniques like vector search and advanced profile representation.
* Innovate with LLMs: Create and deploy AI agents and systems with immediate product impact \- from basic automated data tagging, to advanced features like LLM\-based evaluation judges, all the way to experimental ideas such as synthetic personas.
* Drive Technical Strategy: Provide technical leadership and mentorship on the practical application of AI/LLM techniques, defining best practices for everything from prompt engineering to fine\-tuning and RAG.
* Ensure Reliability: Implement and own LLM observability and evaluation systems to ensure our AI features are reliable, performant, and continuously improving.
* Collaborate Cross\-Functionally: Work closely with data scientists, platform engineers, and research teams to build cohesive, end\-to\-end solutions that push the boundaries of human\-AI interaction.


*Who We're Looking For*
**Core Requirements:**
* A strong track record of designing, building, and shipping AI\-powered features that have solved real business problems.
* An inquisitive and experimental mindset, with a passion for tackling ambiguous problems that may not have established solutions.
* Deep practical knowledge of the modern AI engineering stack (e.g., RAG, vector databases, prompt engineering, fine\-tuning techniques, and evaluation frameworks).
* The ability to thoughtfully balance cutting\-edge research with the practical constraints of production reliability and scalability.


**Deep expertise in one, or both of the following areas:**
* Software Engineering \& Systems Design: Expertise in Python and experience building scalable services (e.g., using FastAPI, Django). You have a strong command of system design, infrastructure, and CI/CD pipelines, and you're comfortable taking a feature from concept to deployment.
* Machine Learning Engineering \& Research: A comprehensive background in machine learning, with deep experience in ML frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face) and a strong grasp of the underlying theory behind the models and techniques you use.


**Bonus Points:**
* Experience with modern LLM orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, DSPy, LangGraph).
* Experience in agentic system design and tool calling (Adk, A2A, MCP, etc.)
* Prior work on human\-in\-the\-loop systems, data annotation platforms, or reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF).
* An interest or experience in synthetic data, human\-in\-the\-loop systems, or AI alignment.
* Experience building robust monitoring and observability for AI/ML systems in production.


*Why Prolific is a great place to work*
 We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high\-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.
   

  

 We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation—one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity.
   

  

 Working for us will place you at the forefront of AI innovation, providing access to our unique human data platform and opportunities for groundbreaking research. Join us to enjoy a competitive salary, benefits, and remote working within our impactful, mission\-driven culture.

description:
**About Wilgot** 


 Wilgot is building the category\-defining Agentic Product Optimization (APO) platform for e\-commerce. We are addressing the "adapt\-or\-die" reality that brands face as search shifts from keyword\-matching to AI\-driven discovery in interfaces like ChatGPT and Google AI Mode. Recognized by Dawn Capital as one of the top AI startups redefining e\-commerce, our platform automates the repositioning of product catalogs for global, recognized brands, ensuring every product finds its buyer through intelligent content.
 



**What we do** 


 Wilgot provides the intelligence layer that transforms "thin" metadata into Intelligent Content optimized for the era of Agentic Commerce.
 




  




**Our Core AI Loop:** 
* **Discover:** 

 Leverage AI and data analysis (customer queries, first\-party data, Google, ChatGPT, Perplexity) across 100\+ markets to identify hidden demand, language attributes, and purchase signals. This phase focuses on turning raw data into clear, actionable content strategy.
* **Generate:** 

 Build and deploy systems that create high\-quality, structured, and intent\-aligned product content (titles, descriptions, attributes, FAQs) natively in 100\+ languages. The goal is to optimize content for both user conversion and interpretation/recommendation by AI search systems.
* **Iterate:** 

 Design and manage a continuous feedback and optimization system. Monitor product performance across major search platforms, then programmatically regenerate and improve content based on visibility, engagement, and conversion data to maintain optimal relevance and discoverability.


- 

**The Role** 


 Having validated our proprietary AI engine, we are now scaling it into a sophisticated, autonomous agentic platform. As a Senior AI Engineer, you will transition from AI theory to solving tangible, high\-scale engineering challenges. You will work alongside our founding team and our Founding AI Scientist (PhD in Reinforcement Learning) to translate cutting\-edge research into enterprise\-scale production features.
 




  




**Key Responsibilities** 
* **Scale Agentic Architectures** 

 : Advance existing workflows into multi\-agent systems capable of autonomous reasoning, state management, and self\-correction.
* **Model Development \& Fine\-Tuning** 

 : Lead the full lifecycle, from designing training strategies and curating high\-quality datasets to executing model fine\-tuning.
* **Advanced Feature Engineering** 

 : Build pipelines that leverage LLMs to extract latent product attributes and consumer intent signals from unstructured data.

title: AI Engineer, AI Lab
description:
**Who We Are**
 We are an organisation that exists to drive progress. That's the “red thread” that connects everyone at The Economist Group (TEG). Our businesses share a devotion to innovation, independence and rigour in their fields of expertise. We empower people to understand and tackle the critical challenges and changes facing the world. Our analytical rigour, global expertise and evidence\-based insights enable individuals and organisations to make sense of these shifts and chart a course through them.
   

  

 We deliver analysis and insights in many formats to subscribers and clients in 170 countries through our four businesses,
 *The Economist,* 
 Economist Impact, Economist Intelligence and Economist Education, which uphold our global reputation for excellence and integrity.
   

  

 The Economist Group is a global media and information services company committed to championing progress. We equip individuals and organisations with expertise, insights, and perspectives to navigate change and drive growth.
   

  

 This is a full\-time role at the centre of our new AI Lab, a small team exploring how generative AI might shape the future of Economist journalism. This role will focus on building and fine\-tuning LLM\-powered systems with a particular focus on editorial tone, style transfer, retrieval workflows, and multimodal generation (especially audio).
   

  

 You’ll ship products from zero\-to\-one and see your ideas directly influence how millions of readers interact with our journalism. If you enjoy working close to design, iterating fast, and building novel interactions across text, voice, and visuals, we’d love to hear from you. You'll be one of the first three engineers in a dedicated lab, working alongside the Tech Lead, Design Lead and Product Lead.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Fine\-tune large language models (LLMs) for style and tone alignment with The Economist’s editorial voice
* Design, curate, and manage datasets used for fine\-tuning, including versioning and annotation workflows
* Build and evaluate RAG pipelines that incorporate retrieval from structured content
* Prototype and test TTS (text\-to\-speech) pipelines for use in audio\-first products (leveraging tools like ElevenLabs, OpenAI TTS etc)
* Collaborate with infra, frontend, and design leads to ship internal tools and demos that explore GenAI capabilities
* Own quality evaluation pipelines (BLEU, ROUGE, editorial scoring, custom evals), including human\-in\-the\-loop feedback loops
* Support product experiments where real\-time generation, summarisation, or personalization are being tested
* Partner directly with journalists and editors to develop novel evaluation metrics that capture the nuances of The Economist's tone and style


**Specific Skills And Expertise**
* 3\+ years experience building with LLMs or NLP pipelines (ideally hands\-on with OpenAI, Claude, Cohere, Gemini, Mistral, HuggingFace)
* Experience with supervised fine\-tuning (SFT), prompt tuning, or instruction tuning on proprietary datasets
* Strong understanding of fine\-tuning paradigms, from SFT to the principles behind RLHF/RLAIF preference modeling
* Strong Python skills, including working with LangChain, HuggingFace Transformers, and data pipelines (Pandas, DVC, Weights \& Biases)
* Comfortable defining and tracking generation quality with eval metrics like BLEU, ROUGE, and building editorial\-specific evaluators
* Exposure to STT / TTS tools for prototyping (e.g., Whisper, ElevenLabs, Bark, etc.)
* Strong communication and collaboration mindset — able to work closely with editorial and product stakeholders
* Curious and exploratory — comfortable working in ambiguity and pushing the boundaries of GenAI capabilities


**Strong Candidates Might Also Have**
* Experience fine\-tuning models for style or persona (e.g. chatbots with specific character voices)
* Exposure to LangSmith or similar observability tools for prompt / LLM testing
* Knowledge of voice synthesis, cloning, or emotion conditioning in audio pipelines
* Previous work in media, journalism, podcasting, or content production contexts
* Familiarity with multi\-modal generation (text \+ image \+ audio), or interest in pushing toward that frontier
* Contributions to open\-source LLM tools or libraries
* An interest in the ethical, editorial, and philosophical questions raised by AI\-generated content


**More About The Economist AI Lab**
 We believe AI will fundamentally change both our business and the world around us, making our mission more vital than ever. While we already use AI across The Economist Group, we think the changes to come in the next few years could be even more far\-reaching.
   

  

 This is why we are launching the Economist AI Lab—to reimagine Economist journalism for an AI\-driven world. It is a deliberately ambitious project, exploring new ideas and possibilities beyond our existing AI initiatives and engineering roadmap.
   

  

 A small, dedicated team, the AI Lab will serve as an innovation engine for The Economist – investigating bold new ideas that will shape how we serve our global audience in the future.
   

  

 AI usage for your application
   

  

 We are an innovative organisation that encourages the use of technology. We recognise that candidates may utilise AI tools to support with their job application process. However, it is essential that all information you provide truthfully and accurately reflects your own experience, skills, and qualifications.
   

  

**What We Offer**
 Our benefits package is designed to support your wellbeing, growth, and work\-life balance. It includes a highly competitive pension or 401(k) plan, private health insurance, and 24/7 access to counselling and wellbeing resources through our Employee Assistance Program.
   

  

 We also offer a range of lifestyle benefits, including our
 *Work From Anywhere* 
 program, which allows you to work from any location where you have the legal right to do so for up to 25 days per year. In addition, we provide generous annual and parental leave, as well as dedicated days off for volunteering and even for moving home.
   

  

 You will also be given free access to all
 *The Economist* 
 content, including an online subscription, our range of apps, podcasts and more.

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
 Senior AI Engineer
   

  

**About Mastercard**
 Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry, connecting billions of consumers, financial institutions, merchants, governments, and businesses worldwide. We are driving the future of commerce by enabling secure, simple, and smart transactions. Artificial Intelligence is at the core of our strategy to make Mastercard stronger and commerce safer, smarter and more personal.
   

  

**The Role**
 At Mastercard, we’re building next\-generation AI\-powered platforms to drive innovation and impact. As a Senior AI Engineer, you’ll work with cutting\-edge tools, large language models (LLMs), and emerging frameworks to develop intelligent systems. You’ll collaborate with senior engineers, data scientists, and product teams—gaining hands\-on experience while contributing to real\-world AI solutions.
   

  

 You’ll help implement Agentic AI systems, develop backend services, and explore new AI capabilities. Your focus will include prompt engineering, guardrail design, and experimentation to ensure safe, scalable, and effective AI applications.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Develop and enhance AI agents and backend systems for Mastercard’s AI platform
* Evaluate LLMs and emerging technologies to identify innovation opportunities
* Design and optimize prompts for LLMs
* Implement safeguards to ensure secure, ethical AI responses
* Build APIs, microservices, and data integrations for AI features
* Write clean, maintainable code following industry best practices
* Stay current with advancements in AI and software engineering


**All About You**
* Strong understanding of AI/ML concepts and enthusiasm for generative AI
* Experience with Python and backend frameworks (e.g., FastAPI, Flask, Node.js)
* Knowledge of REST APIs and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)
* Strong analytical skills and curiosity for exploring new AI capabilities
* Collaborative mindset and openness to feedback and mentorship
* Interest in prompt engineering, AI safety, and scalable deployment


 Why Join Us?
   

  

 At Mastercard, you’ll help shape the future of AI in global commerce—solving complex challenges at scale, driving financial inclusion, and reinforcing the trust and security that define our brand. You’ll work with world\-class talent, cutting\-edge technologies, and will make a lasting impact.
   

  

 \#AI1
   

  

 Mastercard is a merit\-based, inclusive, equal opportunity employer that considers applicants without regard to gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, disabled or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We hire the most qualified candidate for the role. In the US or Canada, if you require accommodations or assistance to complete the online application process or during the recruitment process, please contact reasonable\_accommodation@mastercard.com and identify the type of accommodation or assistance you are requesting. Do not include any medical or health information in this email. The Reasonable Accommodations team will respond to your email promptly.
   

  

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.


 In line with Mastercard’s total compensation philosophy and assuming that the job will be performed in Canada, the successful candidate will be offered a competitive pay based on location, experience and other qualifications for the role and may be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program. This posting reflects one or more current openings on our team.
   

  

**Pay Ranges**
 Toronto, Canada: $83,000 \- $132,000 CAD

 Toronto, Ontario, Canada

 TD is committed to providing fair and equitable compensation opportunities to all colleagues. Growth opportunities and skill development are defining features of the colleague experience at TD. Our compensation policies and practices have been designed to allow colleagues to progress through the salary range over time as they progress in their role. The base pay actually offered may vary based upon the candidate's skills and experience, job\-related knowledge, geographic location, and other specific business and organizational needs.
   

  

 As a candidate, you are encouraged to ask compensation related questions and have an open dialogue with your recruiter who can provide you more specific details for this role.
   

  

**Job Description**
 As part of the AI Platform, our passion is to advance AI capabilities and deliver AI\-powered solutions to optimize processes, maximize productivity, and increase value for our customers and colleagues. We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced AI Engineer to join our team and drive the development of cutting\-edge AI capabilities and solutions on the Azure AI Platform. In this role, you will be at the forefront of designing, implementing, and maintaining knowledge management content vector databases specifically tailored to support our ambitious AI initiatives. Your expertise will help shape the direction of our AI development practices and ensure that our AI solutions meet the highest standards of quality and performance.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Data Engineering and Integration:**
* Design, implement, and manage scalable and efficient data ingestion pipelines for various content types.
* Develop ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) processes to ensure high data quality and integrity.
* Ensure seamless integration of data from multiple sources into vector databases.


**Vector Database Management**
* Configure, optimize, and maintain vector databases for effective storage and retrieval of high\-dimensional content data.
* Implement and optimize indexing and search algorithms to enable efficient and accurate data retrieval.
* Monitor database performance and scalability, addressing any issues promptly.


**Knowledge Management**
* Develop and maintain comprehensive documentation for data ingestion workflows, processes, and best practices.
* Implement and enforce data governance policies to ensure data security, compliance, and quality.
* Manage metadata and data catalogs to enhance data discoverability and usability.


**Collaboration And Communication**
* Work closely with cross\-functional teams, including data scientists, AI researchers, and software engineers, to understand data requirements and provide technical support.


**API Management**
* Understand and utilize API management services for creating, deploying, and managing APIs.
* Develop and maintain APIs to facilitate secure and efficient data access and integration.
* Monitor and optimize API performance, ensuring scalability and reliability.


**Performance Optimization**
* Conduct performance tuning and optimization of data ingestion pipelines and vector databases.
* Implement techniques to enhance the speed and efficiency of data processing and retrieval.
* Monitor system performance metrics and make necessary adjustments to meet performance targets.


**Security And Compliance**
* Implement security best practices for data ingestion pipelines and vector databases to protect sensitive data.
* Ensure compliance with relevant data protection regulations and industry standards.


**Experience \& Education**
* University or post\-graduate degree
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field.
* 7\+ years of proven experience in data engineering.
* Experience with designing and implementing large\-scaled data processing pipelines.
* Strong understanding of data platform architectures, data modeling, ETL processes, and data pipeline design.
* Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure (preferred) and big data technologies.
* Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Spark, Java, or Scala.
* Experience with vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Milvus, FAISS) and related tools.
* Understanding of API management services for creating, deploying, and managing APIs.
* In\-depth knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices, particularly GitHub Actions.
* Understanding of machine learning concepts, MLOps, and familiarity with AI frameworks.
* Understanding of natural language processing, machine learning, MCP, RAG and Agentic AI
* Excellent problem\-solving skills and attention to detail.
* Strong communication and teamwork abilities.


**Who We Are**
 TD is one of the world's leading global financial institutions and is the fifth largest bank in North America by branches/stores. Every day, we deliver legendary customer experiences to over 27 million households and businesses in Canada, the United States and around the world. More than 95,000 TD colleagues bring their skills, talent, and creativity to the Bank, those we serve, and the economies we support. We are guided by our vision to Be the Better Bank and our purpose to enrich the lives of our customers, communities and colleagues.
   

  

 TD is deeply committed to being a leader in customer experience, that is why we believe that all colleagues, no matter where they work, are customer facing. As we build our business and deliver on our strategy, we are innovating to enhance the customer experience and build capabilities to shape the future of banking. Whether you’ve got years of banking experience or are just starting your career in financial services, we can help you realize your potential. Through regular leadership and development conversations to mentorship and training programs, we’re here to support you towards your goals. As an organization, we keep growing – and so will you.
   

  

**Our Total Rewards Package**
 Our Total Rewards package reflects the investments we make in our colleagues to help them and their families achieve their financial, physical, and mental well\-being goals. Total Rewards at TD includes a base salary, variable compensation, and several other key plans such as health and well\-being benefits, savings and retirement programs, paid time off, banking benefits and discounts, career development, and reward and recognition programs. Learn more
   

  

**Additional Information**
 We’re delighted that you’re considering building a career with TD. Through regular development conversations, training programs, and a competitive benefits plan, we’re committed to providing the support our colleagues need to thrive both at work and at home.
   

  

 Please be advised that this job opportunity is subject to provincial regulation for employment purposes. It is imperative to acknowledge that each province or territory within the jurisdiction of Canada may have its own set of regulations, requirements.
   

  

**Colleague Development**
 If you’re interested in a specific career path or are looking to build certain skills, we want to help you succeed. You’ll have regular career, development, and performance conversations with your manager, as well as access to an online learning platform and a variety of mentoring programs to help you unlock future opportunities. Whether you have a passion for helping customers and want to expand your experience, or you want to coach and inspire your colleagues, there are many different career paths within our organization at TD – and we’re committed to helping you identify opportunities that support your goals.
   

  

**Training \& Onboarding**
 We will provide training and onboarding sessions to ensure that you’ve got everything you need to succeed in your new role.
   

  

**Interview Process**
 We’ll reach out to candidates of interest to schedule an interview. We do our best to communicate outcomes to all applicants by email or phone call.
   

  

**Accommodation**
 Your accessibility is important to us. Please let us know if you’d like accommodations (including accessible meeting rooms, captioning for virtual interviews, etc.) to help us remove barriers so that you can participate throughout the interview process.
   

  

 We look forward to hearing from you!

description:
Medisca is a global company leveraging strong partnerships to serve healthcare professionals across diverse wellness disciplines. Offering extensive and essential solutions \- including pharmaceutical ingredients and service, mixing technology manufacturing, analytical testing, and education – **Medisca is bridging the gaps in healthcare** with an unwavering commitment to precision, innovation, and societal impact.



The **Data Manager** is responsible for establishing and leading the organization's data function, with a focus on formalizing data governance, enabling advanced analytics, securing data assets, and ensuring regulatory compliance. This role will define and implement the enterprise data strategy, oversee data classification and protection, and manage the analytics ecosystem, including BI platforms, data pipelines, and reporting standards.



A key component of this role is to enable and support AI initiatives by ensuring high\-quality, well\-governed data is available for machine learning, predictive analytics, and automation use cases. The Data Manager will work cross\-functionally with IT, security, compliance, and business stakeholders to ensure that data is accurate, accessible, secure, and aligned with organizational goals.



The location is based in **Montreal.**



The position is **on site.**


**The Opportunity**



Enterprise Data Strategy


* Develop and implement a scalable data strategy aligned with business, compliance, and AI enablement goals.
* Define data architecture standards, including modeling, lineage, integration, and storage.
* Lead the adoption of modern data platforms (e.g., Azure Synapse, Microsoft Purview, Power BI).
* Collaborate with IT, AI/ML teams, and business units to ensure data infrastructure supports analytics and intelligent automation.


Data Governance \& Classification


* Establish and enforce data governance policies covering ownership, stewardship, and lifecycle management.
* Implement data classification frameworks using Microsoft Purview to tag and categorize sensitive and AI\-relevant data.
* Define and manage metadata standards, data dictionaries, and lineage tracking.
* Ensure data quality through validation rules, profiling, and remediation workflows.


Data Security \& Regulatory Compliance


* Work with cybersecurity and compliance teams to secure data assets across cloud and on\-prem environments.
* Enforce access controls, encryption standards, and conditional access policies.
* Ensure compliance with data privacy regulations (e.g., GDPR, CCPA, Quebec Law 25\).
* Lead internal audits and risk assessments related to data handling and reporting.


Analytics \& BI Operations


* Oversee the design, development, and maintenance of dashboards, reports, and analytics tools.
* Manage BI platforms (e.g., Power BI, Tableau) and ensure consistent data definitions across reports.
* Support data analysts and business units with curated datasets and semantic models.
* Promote self\-service analytics and data literacy across the organization.


AI \& Advanced Analytics Enablement


* Ensure data readiness for AI/ML initiatives, including structured, labeled, and high\-quality datasets.
* Collaborate with data scientists and AI engineers to support model training, validation, and deployment.
* Implement data pipelines and governance controls for AI workloads.
* Monitor data drift, bias, and lineage in AI models to ensure ethical and compliant use.


Team Leadership \& Management


* Lead and develop a high\-performing data team, including data analysts, data stewards, and BI specialists.
* Provide mentorship, coaching, and professional development opportunities to team members.
* Set clear goals, performance metrics, and priorities aligned with enterprise data strategy and business needs.
* Foster a collaborative, inclusive, and results\-driven team culture that encourages innovation and accountability.
* Manage team workload, resource planning, and hiring to ensure the right skills are in place to support data governance, analytics, and AI initiatives.
* Serve as a liaison between the data team and other departments, ensuring effective communication and alignment on projects and objectives.


**Qualifications:**


* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field.
* 6–10 years of experience in data management, governance, or analytics roles.
* Experience implementing data governance and classification frameworks.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Purview, Azure Synapse, and Power BI.
* Exposure to AI/ML workflows and data preparation for model development.
* Experience working in regulated environments or with compliance frameworks.
* Data Governance: Microsoft Purview, metadata management, data cataloging
* Security \& Compliance: Azure Information Protection, RBAC, encryption, Law 25, GDPR
* Data Architecture: Data modeling, lineage, ETL design, Azure Synapse
* BI \& Analytics: Power BI, DAX, SQL, semantic modeling
* AI Enablement: Data labeling, feature engineering, ML pipeline support
* Integration \& Automation: Azure Data Factory, REST APIs, Python
* Monitoring \& Quality: Data profiling, validation rules, anomaly detection
* Strategic Thinking: Ability to define and execute a long\-term data and AI vision.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Works effectively with IT, AI/ML, security, and business teams.
* Communication: Strong ability to translate technical concepts for non\-technical audiences.
* Attention to Detail: Ensures accuracy in classification, reporting, and compliance.
* Change Leadership: Drives adoption of new tools, policies, and practices.
* Problem Solving: Analytical mindset with a focus on root cause analysis and continuous improvement.
* Excellent communication skills; fluent French and English (oral \& written) required.


**What’s in it for you…**



We invest time and resources into making sure Medisca is as good as the people we hire.


* Work/Life Balance \- 37\.50 hour workweek with early Fridays all year long, PTO and vacation policy
* Invest in your health – Choice of modular plans, health spending account and free Telemedicine
* Flexible work environment – Hybrid work schedule with home office reimbursement program
* Your Future is Bright – Opportunities to learn and grow within Medisca
* Save for your Future – Medisca contributes to a deferred profit sharing plan (DPSP) when you invest in RRSPs
* Help us grow – Employee Referral Program
* Central location \- Free parking/accessible by public transportation; a commercial center is within walking distance for lunch or groceries
* We like to have fun – company events throughout the year


We thank all applicants for their interest; however, only candidates to be interviewed will be contacted.



We are an equal opportunity employer.



\#LI\-Onsite

  



Medisca est une entreprise mondiale qui s’appuie sur des partenariats solides pour servir les professionnels de la santé dans diverses disciplines liées au bien\-être. En proposant des solutions complètes et essentielles, y compris des ingrédients et des services pharmaceutiques, la fabrication de technologies de mélange, des tests analytiques et la formation, **Medisca comble les lacunes en matière de soins de santé** grâce à un engagement inébranlable en faveur de la précision, de l’innovation et de l’impact sociétal.



Le **gestionnaire de données** est chargé d’établir et de diriger la fonction de données de l’organisation, en mettant l’accent sur la formalisation de la gouvernance des données, la mise en œuvre d’analyses avancées, la sécurisation des actifs de données et la garantie de la conformité réglementaire. Il définira et mettra en œuvre la stratégie de données de l’entreprise, supervisera la classification et la protection des données et gérera l’écosystème analytique, y compris les plateformes d’informatique décisionnelle, les pipelines de données et les normes d’établissement des rapports.



Un élément clé de ce rôle est de permettre et de soutenir les initiatives d’IA en veillant à ce que des données de haute qualité et bien gouvernées soient disponibles pour les cas d’apprentissage automatique, d’analyse prédictive et d’utilisation de l’automatisation. Le gestionnaire de données travaillera de manière transversale avec les départements informatique, sécurité, conformité et les parties prenantes de l’entreprise pour s’assurer que les données sont exactes, accessibles, sécurisées et alignées sur les objectifs de l’organisation.



Le poste est situé à **Montréal.**



Le poste est **sur site**.


**L'opportunité**



Stratégie de données d’entreprise


* Développer et mettre en œuvre une stratégie de données évolutive alignée sur les objectifs de commerce, de conformité et de mise en œuvre de l’IA.
* Définir les normes d’architecture des données, y compris la modélisation, la traçabilité, l’intégration et le stockage.
* Diriger l’adoption de plateformes de données modernes (par exemple, Azure Synapse, Microsoft Purview, Power BI).
* Collaborer avec les équipes informatiques, IA/AA et les unités commerciales afin de garantir que l’infrastructure de données prend en charge l’analyse et l’automatisation intelligente.


Gouvernance et classification des données


* Établir et appliquer des politiques de gouvernance des données couvrant la propriété, la gérance et la gestion du cycle de vie.
* Mettre en œuvre des cadres de classification des données à l’aide de Microsoft Purview pour étiqueter et catégoriser les données sensibles et pertinentes pour l’IA.
* Définir et gérer les normes relatives aux métadonnées, les dictionnaires de données et la traçabilité.
* Assurer la qualité des données grâce à des règles de validation, au profilage et à des flux de travail de remédiation.


Sécurité des données et conformité réglementaire


* Collaborer avec les équipes chargées de la cybersécurité et de la conformité pour sécuriser les données dans les environnements cloud ou locaux.
* Appliquer des contrôles d’accès, des normes de cryptage et des politiques d’accès conditionnel.
* Assurer la conformité avec les réglementations en matière de confidentialité des données (par exemple, RGPD, CCPA, Loi 25 au Québec).
* Diriger les audits internes et les évaluations des risques liés au traitement des données et à l’établissement des rapports.


Opérations d’analyse et d’informatique décisionnelle


* Superviser la conception, le développement et la maintenance des tableaux de bord, des rapports et des outils d’analyse.
* Gérer les plateformes d’informatique décisionnelle (par exemple, Power BI, Tableau) et assurer la cohérence des définitions de données dans les rapports.
* Soutenir les analystes de données et les unités commerciales avec des ensembles de données et des modèles sémantiques.
* Promouvoir l’analyse en libre\-service et la maîtrise des données dans l’ensemble de l’organisation.


Mise en œuvre de l’IA et de l’analyse avancée


* Veiller à ce que les données soient prêtes pour les initiatives d’IA/AA, y compris les ensembles de données structurés, étiquetés et de haute qualité.
* Collaborer avec les data scientists et les ingénieurs en IA pour soutenir l’entraînement, la validation et le déploiement des modèles.
* Mettre en œuvre des pipelines de données et des contrôles de gouvernance pour les charges de travail d’IA.
* Surveiller la dérive des données, les biais et la traçabilité dans les modèles d’IA afin de garantir une utilisation éthique et conforme.


Leadership et gestion d’équipe


* Diriger et développer une équipe de données performante, comprenant des analystes de données, des gestionnaires de données et des spécialistes en informatique décisionnelle.
* Fournir aux membres de l’équipe des opportunités de mentorat, de coaching et de développement professionnel.
* Fixer des objectifs clairs, des mesures de performance et des priorités alignées sur la stratégie de données de l’entreprise et les besoins commerciaux.
* Favoriser une culture d’équipe collaborative, inclusive et axée sur les résultats, qui encourage l’innovation et la responsabilité.
* Gérer la charge de travail de l’équipe, la planification des ressources et l’embauche pour s’assurer que les bonnes compétences sont en place pour soutenir la gouvernance des données, l’analyse et les initiatives d’IA.
* Assurer la liaison entre l’équipe chargée des données et les autres départements, en veillant à une communication efficace et à un alignement sur les projets et les objectifs.


**Qualifications:**


* Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en science des données, en systèmes d’information, en informatique ou dans un domaine connexe.
* 6 à 10 ans d’expérience dans la gestion des données, la gouvernance ou l’analyse.
* Expérience de la mise en œuvre de cadres de gouvernance et de classification des données.
* Connaissance de Microsoft Purview, Azure Synapse et Power BI.
* Expérience des flux de travail IA/AA et de la préparation des données pour le développement de modèles.
* Expérience de travail dans des environnements réglementés ou avec des cadres de conformité.
* Gouvernance des données : Microsoft Purview, gestion des métadonnées, catalogage des données
* Sécurité et conformité : Azure Information Protection, RBAC, chiffrement, Loi 25, RGPD
* Architecture des données : Modélisation des données, traçabilité, conception ETL, Azure Synapse
* Informatique décisionnelle et analyse : Power BI, DAX, SQL, modélisation sémantique
* Mise en œuvre de l’IA : Étiquetage des données, ingénierie des caractéristiques, soutien aux pipelines d’AA
* Intégration et automatisation : Azure Data Factory, API REST, Python
* Surveillance et qualité : Profilage des données, règles de validation, détection des anomalies
* Réflexion stratégique : Capacité à définir et à mettre en œuvre une vision à long terme en matière de données et d’IA.
* Collaboration interfonctionnelle : Travaille efficacement avec les équipes informatiques, d’IA/AA, de sécurité et de commerce.
* Communication : Grande capacité à traduire des concepts techniques pour un public non initié.
* Souci du détail : Veiller à l’exactitude de la classification, de l’établissement des rapports et de la conformité.
* Leadership du changement : Favorise l’adoption de nouveaux outils, de nouvelles politiques et de nouvelles pratiques.
* Résolution de problèmes : Esprit analytique avec un accent sur l’analyse des causes profondes et l’amélioration continue.
* Excellentes aptitudes à la communication : français et anglais (oral et écrit) courants exigés.


**Ce que cela vous apporte...**

 \*\*
